title: CampaignStory
description: data/running/owner/stories/<campaign-id>.yaml: a campaign's approved story, the only place story text lives (FR-055). Only approved text may enter this file (FR-050, FR-052).

campaign.description: Equals the file name, and is a campaign ID.

text.description:
Non-empty plain text. Blank lines separate paragraphs. No HTML or Markdown: rendered as

elements, escaped.
text.x-error: must be the story's text, not empty

approved.description: The owner's approval, written by scripts/approve-story.ts after their explicit yes (FR-052).
approved.x-error: needs the owner's approval before it can be published

date.description: The date the owner approved the text. Not in the future.

text_sha256.description: The sha256 of the text field as parsed. A mismatch means the text changed after approval (SC-007).
text_sha256.x-error: is not a sha256 (64 lower-case hexadecimal characters)
